notes: Psalms 108:3 3 I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
Probably David penned this psalm with a view to Doeg or Ahithophel, and hence it is much like the 41st, 52nd, 55th, 124th, and 140th
Psalms 109:1 1 ¶ TO the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
